name: UCLA Regents Scholarship
amount: $2,000 per year for up to 4 years (freshmen); up to 2 years (transfers)
eligibility: California resident and U.S. citizen or permanent resident. Entering freshman or transfer student selected for demonstrated academic excellence, leadership, and exceptional promise.
description: Competitive merit scholarship for entering UCLA freshmen and transfer students.
requirements_raw: California residency; U.S. citizenship or permanent residency; entering freshman or transfer status; academic excellence, leadership, and exceptional promise.

name: Forty Acres Scholars Program
amount: Full ride (amount varies by student cost of attendance)
eligibility: High school senior applying to UT Austin; U.S. citizen or permanent resident; in-state and out-of-state students eligible. Transfer and international students are not eligible.
leadership: Leadership, community service, and servant leadership
description: Merit-based full-ride scholarship for exceptional entering UT Austin students.
requirements_raw: Apply to UT Austin through Common App or ApplyTexas; high school senior; U.S. citizen or permanent resident; demonstrated academic excellence, leadership, extracurricular involvement, community service, intellectual curiosity, and good citizenship.

name: Florida Presidential Platinum Scholarship
amount: $10,000 per year
eligibility: High-achieving Florida resident admitted to the University of Florida and selected through UF's scholarship review.
source_name: University of Florida Student Financial Affairs
description: University of Florida merit scholarship for selected high-achieving Florida residents.
requirements_raw: Florida residency; UF admission; selection by UF scholarship committee. Award value published as $10,000 per year.

name: Michael L. Probst Scholarship
amount: $2,500 for one year
eligibility: NYU Liberal Studies student at the end of the freshman year with at least 32 credits, no outstanding incomplete grades or disciplinary sanctions, and full-time fall enrollment. Application includes an essay.
description: One-year academic-merit scholarship for eligible NYU Liberal Studies sophomores.
requirements_raw: Academic merit; 3.85 cumulative NYU GPA; 32 credits; no incomplete grades or disciplinary sanctions; full-time fall enrollment; essay application.

name: Penn State Discover Award
amount: $6,000 per academic year; up to $24,000 over four years for first-year baccalaureate students
eligibility: First-time, first-year domestic student who enrolls at a Penn State campus other than University Park or World Campus immediately after high school. U.S. citizens or permanent residents who are not Pennsylvania residents are automatically reviewed.
description: Automatic-review award for eligible out-of-state students attending Penn State Commonwealth Campuses.
requirements_raw: Domestic U.S. citizen or permanent resident; non-Pennsylvania resident; enroll at a Penn State campus other than University Park or World Campus; automatic review for eligible admitted students.

name: Illinois Commitment
amount: Full tuition and campus fees for up to 4 years
eligibility: Illinois resident and U.S. citizen or eligible noncitizen; family income and assets each $75,000 or less; under 24; Illinois high school graduate; admitted new freshman or transfer; enrolled at least 12 hours in a baccalaureate program.
source_name: Illinois Office of Student Financial Aid
description: Need-based package covering tuition and campus fees for qualifying Illinois students.
requirements_raw: Illinois resident; U.S. citizen or eligible noncitizen; family income and assets no more than $75,000; under age 24; Illinois high-school graduate; new freshman or transfer; FAFSA before March 15; baccalaureate enrollment of at least 12 hours.

name: Land Grant Opportunity Scholarship
amount: Full cost of attendance
eligibility: Ohio resident, Pell-eligible undergraduate with significant financial need and demonstrated academic merit. Ohio State automatically considers eligible applicants; 176 Ohio students are awarded each year.
source_name: The Ohio State University Strategic Enrollment Management
description: Full-cost scholarship for selected high-need, academically strong Ohio students.
requirements_raw: Ohio resident; Federal Pell Grant eligibility; significant financial need; academic merit; automatic consideration through Ohio State admission process.

name: Stamps President's Scholars Program
amount: Full ride for 4 years
eligibility: Top first-year Georgia Tech applicants selected by the Office of Scholar Programs. The program is offered annually to approximately the top one percent of first-year students.
source_name: Georgia Tech Office of Scholarships and Financial Aid
description: Prestigious Georgia Tech four-year full-ride scholarship for selected first-year students.
requirements_raw: First-year Georgia Tech applicant; selection by Office of Scholar Programs; highly competitive merit selection among the top one percent of first-year students.

name: Morehead-Cain Scholarship
amount: Fully funded 4-year undergraduate experience
eligibility: Students eligible through a nominating school or affiliate program, North Carolina direct application, or the UNC admissions referral process. Selection emphasizes leadership, moral force of character, scholarship, and physical vigor.
description: Merit scholarship program funding four years at UNC-Chapel Hill plus four summer enrichment experiences.
requirements_raw: Eligibility depends on applicant location and nominating-school or affiliate-program status; some out-of-state applicants may be considered through UNC's Admissions Referral Program. Selection assesses leadership, moral force of character, scholarship, and physical vigor.

name: Go Blue Guarantee
provider: University of Michigan College of Literature, Science, and the Arts
amount: Full tuition
eligibility: In-state student admitted to the University of Michigan whose family income is $125,000 or less and assets are $125,000 or less.
description: Tuition guarantee for qualifying in-state University of Michigan students.
requirements_raw: University of Michigan admission; in-state residency; family income of $125,000 or less; family assets of $125,000 or less; financial-aid eligibility.

name: Scarlet Guarantee
amount: In-state tuition and eligible fees after other qualifying aid
eligibility: Qualified Rutgers–New Brunswick students with fewer than 60 credits. Program is a last-dollar award for in-state tuition and eligible fees.
description: Rutgers–New Brunswick last-dollar financial-aid program for early undergraduate study.
requirements_raw: Qualified Rutgers–New Brunswick student; fewer than 60 credits; award covers remaining in-state tuition and eligible fees after other qualifying aid.

name: AccessUVA
amount: Up to full tuition, required fees, housing, and food based on need
eligibility: Eligible undergraduate students with demonstrated financial need. Virginia families earning $50,000 or less with assets under $100,000 receive grants and scholarships equivalent to at least tuition, fees, housing, and food; qualifying families earning $100,000 or less receive at least tuition and required fees.
description: UVA need-based grant and scholarship commitment for eligible undergraduates.
requirements_raw: Demonstrated financial need; eligibility for undergraduate financial aid. Published Virginia family income and asset thresholds determine the minimum grant and scholarship coverage.

name: Husky Promise
amount: Full tuition and standard fees
eligibility: Eligible Washington resident University of Washington students with financial need.
source_name: University of Washington Office of Admissions
description: UW guarantee that grant or scholarship support covers tuition and standard fees for eligible Washington residents.
requirements_raw: Washington residency; financial-aid eligibility and demonstrated need. Full tuition and standard fees are covered through grants or scholarships for eligible students.

name: Arizona Promise Grant
amount: Remaining tuition, mandatory fees, and college fees after other gift aid
eligibility: Arizona resident, Pell-eligible, first-year University of Arizona student. Award may continue up to four years.
source_name: University of Arizona Office of Scholarships & Financial Aid
description: State grant filling eligible first-year Arizona students' tuition and fee gap after other gift aid.
requirements_raw: Arizona resident; Federal Pell Grant eligible; first-year University of Arizona student; complete admission application by the published priority filing date; award fills tuition and eligible fee gap after other gift aid.

name: In-State Volunteer Scholarship
amount: $3,000–$9,000 per year (published 2025–26 scale)
eligibility: Tennessee first-year student enrolled at UT immediately after senior year of high school. Award is based on exemplary high-school GPA and ACT/SAT score.
source_name: UT Knoxville One Stop Student Services
description: Renewable UT Knoxville merit scholarship for academically strong Tennessee first-year students.
requirements_raw: Tennessee resident; first-year enrollment immediately after high-school graduation; selection by UT core weighted GPA and ACT/SAT score. Published 2025–26 annual amounts range from $3,000 to $9,000 and programs may change annually.

name: ASPIRE Community Scholarship
amount: Amount varies
eligibility: Incoming first-year Commonwealth Honors College student who is first-generation, shows outstanding academic potential and financial need, and intends to pursue medicine or medical research.
description: Four-year UMass Amherst scholarship supporting a first-generation student pursuing medicine or medical research.
requirements_raw: Incoming first-year Commonwealth Honors College student; first-generation; outstanding academic potential; financial need; intended medicine or medical-research career; four-year award.

name: Wells Scholars Program
amount: Up to full cost of attendance for 4 years
eligibility: Exceptional incoming first-year students selected on merit. Nomination and required materials are due by the published deadline; selection considers academic accomplishment, character, leadership, extracurricular involvement, community concern, and global interest.
source_name: Indiana University Bloomington Office of Scholarships
description: IU Bloomington's premier four-year merit program for selected incoming students.
requirements_raw: Incoming first-year student; nomination; exceptional academic accomplishment and promise, character, leadership, extracurricular involvement, community concern, and global interest. Available to in-state, out-of-state, and international students.

name: Terrapin Commitment
amount: Standard in-state tuition and mandatory fees after other aid
eligibility: Full-time, in-state, degree-seeking undergraduate with Federal Pell Grant eligibility or total family income of $75,000 or less and unmet financial need. Must submit FAFSA annually and maintain satisfactory academic progress.
source_name: University of Maryland Office of Student Financial Aid
description: UMD need-based grant covering remaining standard in-state tuition and fees for eligible Maryland students.
requirements_raw: Maryland in-state undergraduate; degree seeking; full-time enrollment; FAFSA by March 1; Pell eligible or family income at or below $75,000 with unmet need; satisfactory academic progress.

name: Missouri Land Grant
amount: Full tuition and mandatory fees after other qualifying aid
eligibility: Missouri resident at admission; full-time undergraduate pursuing a first bachelor's degree; Federal Pell Grant eligible; FAFSA submitted annually; satisfactory academic progress.
source_name: University of Missouri Student Financial Aid
description: Automatically awarded Mizzou grant covering qualifying students' tuition and mandatory fees.
requirements_raw: Missouri resident at admission; first bachelor's degree; full-time fall or spring enrollment; FAFSA annually by priority deadline; Federal Pell Grant eligibility; satisfactory academic progress. Award is available within a continuous eligibility period.

name: Bucky's Tuition Promise
amount: Full tuition and segregated fees
eligibility: New Wisconsin resident first-year or transfer student in an on-campus program with family adjusted gross income of $65,000 or less and pursuing a first bachelor's degree.
source_name: UW–Madison Office of Student Financial Aid
description: UW–Madison guarantee of tuition and segregated-fee support for eligible Wisconsin residents.
requirements_raw: Wisconsin resident; new incoming first-year or transfer student in an on-campus first bachelor's program; family AGI at or below $65,000; FAFSA annually; CSS Profile in incoming year. Four years for first-year students and two years for transfers.

name: CU Boulder Chancellor's Achievement Scholarship
amount: $6,250 per year; $25,000 total over 4 years
eligibility: Incoming nonresident CU Boulder first-year student with a completed admission application by January 15. Selection considers academic achievement, personal background, and the strength of the admission application.
source_name: CU Boulder Office of Scholarship Services
description: Renewable four-year merit scholarship for selected nonresident CU Boulder first-year students.
requirements_raw: Incoming nonresident first-year student; completed CU Boulder admission application by January 15; selection based on admission materials; maintain nonresident tuition status, full-time enrollment, and satisfactory academic progress.

name: North Star Promise Scholarship
amount: Remaining resident tuition and covered fees after other gift aid
eligibility: Minnesota resident student with family adjusted gross income below $80,000 who meets the program's financial-aid requirements.
source_name: University of Minnesota Twin Cities One Stop
description: State-funded last-dollar scholarship covering qualifying Minnesota residents' resident tuition and specified fees.
requirements_raw: Minnesota resident; family adjusted gross income below $80,000 as determined by FAFSA; meet state-program requirements; submit FAFSA or Minnesota Dream Act by published deadline. Renewable up to eight full-time semesters or equivalent while eligible.

name: Gamecock Guarantee
amount: At least $5,000 per year; tuition, technology fee, and average program fees covered when combined with other gift aid
eligibility: South Carolina resident, first-generation, first-time full-time freshman at USC Columbia from a low-income household who is Pell eligible and meets program application and FAFSA requirements.
source_name: University of South Carolina Financial Aid and Scholarships
description: Need-based financial and academic support program for selected first-generation South Carolina students.
requirements_raw: South Carolina resident; first-time, full-time USC Columbia freshman; first-generation; low-income household; Pell Grant eligible; admission application by December 1; FAFSA and requested documentation by April 1. No separate application; eligible students are invited based on capacity.

name: President's Alumni Scholars Award
amount: Full cost of attendance for 4 years plus $2,000 study-abroad stipend
eligibility: Prospective LSU freshmen selected through the admission process for elite academic achievement, leadership, and service. Finalists complete an essay, resume, and Scholars Weekend interview.
description: LSU's premier four-year award for selected entering students.
requirements_raw: Completed LSU Common Application and required documentation by December 1 priority deadline; elite academic achievement, leadership, and service; selection through semifinalist essay and resume review, then Scholars Weekend interview for finalists.

name: Provost Scholarship
amount: Amount varies by academic credentials and residency; renewable up to 4 years
eligibility: Incoming full-time University of Kentucky undergraduate beginning the fall after high-school graduation. Award is based on academic credentials submitted with the admission application and residency status.
description: Renewable UK academic scholarship for eligible incoming undergraduates.
requirements_raw: Incoming full-time undergraduate; begins fall after high-school graduation; award value determined by admission academic credentials and residency; renewable for up to eight semesters under the published terms.

name: PathwayOregon
amount: Full tuition and fees for up to 4 years
eligibility: Oregon resident who graduated from an Oregon high school in the past two years, is admitted as a first-time freshman, and is eligible for the Federal Pell Grant.
description: UO program combining federal, state, and university aid to pay tuition and fees for eligible Oregon students.
requirements_raw: Oregon resident; Oregon high-school graduate within two years; first-time freshman; minimum 3.40 high-school GPA; Pell Grant eligible; UO admission application and FAFSA by published deadlines. Tuition and fees only; housing, books, and meals are excluded.

name: Crimson Commitment
amount: Tuition and up to $8,300 in average fees
eligibility: Direct-from-high-school, first-time, full-time OU freshman who fully qualifies for Oklahoma's Promise and meets OU admission and FAFSA deadlines.
description: OU guarantee using scholarships and grants to cover tuition and average fees for qualifying Oklahoma's Promise recipients.
requirements_raw: Oklahoma's Promise recipient; apply to OU by published deadline; direct-from-high-school, first-time, full-time freshman; FAFSA by published deadline; full-time enrollment each semester. Tuition and fees vary by major.

name: UConn Promise Grants
amount: Amount varies
eligibility: Eligible recipients of New Haven, Hartford, or Waterbury Promise Program benefits who enroll at UConn. A UConn Undergraduate Admissions Merit Scholarship fulfills UConn's Promise Program commitment.
source_name: University of Connecticut Student Financial Aid Services
description: UConn grant program supporting eligible students from designated Connecticut Promise Programs.
requirements_raw: Recipient of benefits from New Haven, Hartford, or Waterbury Promise Program; UConn enrollment. UConn Undergraduate Admissions Merit Scholarship recipients are considered to have the UConn Promise commitment fulfilled.

name: For Utah Scholarship
amount: Remaining tuition and mandatory fees after other grants and scholarships
eligibility: First-time, first-year Utah resident who is Pell Grant eligible, meets the published admission and FAFSA deadlines, and enrolls at the University of Utah main campus.
source_name: University of Utah Financial Aid and Scholarships
description: Last-dollar Utah tuition-and-fee scholarship for qualifying Pell-eligible first-year students.
requirements_raw: Utah resident; first-time, first-year student; Federal Pell Grant eligible; at least 3.20 unweighted cumulative high-school GPA; complete U admissions and FAFSA by published deadlines. Covers remaining tuition and mandatory fees for up to four years while renewal requirements are met.

name: Alabama's Promise
amount: $4,000 per academic year
eligibility: Alabama high-school graduate age 25 or younger transferring in good standing from an Alabama community college after an associate degree or qualifying general-education coursework; Pell eligible with the published expected family contribution threshold.
description: Need-based University of Alabama transfer award for eligible Alabama community-college students.
requirements_raw: Alabama high-school graduate; associate degree with 3.0 cumulative GPA from an Alabama community college or at least 45 general-education hours with 3.0 GPA; transfer in good standing; age 25 or younger; FAFSA qualifying for partial or full Pell Grant with expected family contribution at or below published threshold; full-time enrollment. Funding is limited and awarded by admission and FAFSA date.

name: Iowa State Transfer Success Award
amount: $9,000 total; $3,000 per year for up to 3 years
eligibility: Nonresident transfer student admitted to Iowa State for fall or spring, pursuing a first bachelor's degree and enrolling full-time after prior postsecondary study.
description: Automatic renewable scholarship for eligible nonresident Iowa State transfer students.
requirements_raw: Nonresident transfer student; minimum 3.00 cumulative transferable academic GPA; full-time enrollment at Iowa State; first bachelor's degree; maintain 2.50 Iowa State GPA and continuous full-time nonresident enrollment for renewal.

name: Governor Guinn Millennium Scholarship
amount: $80 per credit hour, up to $10,000 lifetime
eligibility: Nevada high-school graduate who was a Nevada resident for at least two years of high school and completed the required college-preparatory curriculum.
description: State merit scholarship for qualifying Nevada high-school graduates attending UNLV.
requirements_raw: Nevada high-school diploma; Nevada resident for at least two high-school years; minimum 3.25 GPA or qualifying ACT/SAT; required English, math, science, and social-science curriculum. Maintain 2.75 semester GPA, 12 credits, and satisfactory academic progress.

name: New Arkansan Non-Resident Tuition Award
amount: 50%–90% of the out-of-state tuition differential
eligibility: Eligible incoming nonresident University of Arkansas undergraduate from a participating surrounding or extended state. Award percentage depends on residence category and GPA.
source_name: University of Arkansas Academic Scholarship Office
description: Automatic nonresident tuition-differential award for eligible incoming University of Arkansas students.
requirements_raw: Degree-seeking incoming student; admission application; eligibility depends on residence state and GPA. Published 2026–27 awards range from 50% to 90% of the out-of-state tuition difference. Renewal requires at least 24 annual hours and 2.75 cumulative GPA.

name: Stamps Scholarship
amount: Full cost of attendance plus $12,000 enrichment fund
eligibility: First-time University of Mississippi freshman with exceptional academic and leadership record selected through the competitive scholarship process.
description: Ole Miss's premier competitive scholarship for selected entering students.
requirements_raw: First-time freshman; admission application and Freshman Scholarship Application by January 10; exceptional academic and leadership record. Award includes up to cost of attendance after other awards and a $12,000 enrichment stipend.

name: Chancellor Scholarship
amount: $5,000 per year; $20,000 over 4 years
eligibility: Kansas resident incoming KU freshman enrolled in an eligible on-campus bachelor's program.
description: Renewable KU in-state merit scholarship for high-achieving incoming Kansas students.
requirements_raw: Kansas resident for tuition purposes; incoming eligible bachelor's student; 3.95 or higher GPA for the published Chancellor award level. Scholarship information is reviewed annually.

name: New Mexico Opportunity Scholarship
amount: 100% tuition and mandatory fees; course fees up to $50 per credit
eligibility: New Mexico resident recent graduate or returning learner without a prior bachelor's degree who meets enrollment and academic-progress requirements.
source_name: University of New Mexico Scholarship Office
description: Automatic state scholarship for eligible UNM New Mexico resident students.
requirements_raw: New Mexico resident; no prior bachelor's degree; recent graduate or eligible returning learner; no application required. Covers tuition and mandatory fees up to 160 attempted hours; GPA and enrollment requirements vary by learner type.

name: Nebraska Promise
amount: Undergraduate tuition for up to 30 credits per academic year
eligibility: Nebraska resident full-time, degree-seeking undergraduate who is Pell eligible or whose family AGI is $65,000 or less.
source_name: University of Nebraska Office of Scholarships & Financial Aid
description: Last-dollar Nebraska tuition guarantee through combined federal, state, and campus aid.
requirements_raw: Nebraska resident; full-time degree-seeking undergraduate; Pell Grant eligible or family AGI at or below $65,000; FAFSA annually by published deadline; maintain 2.50 GPA. Tuition covered for fall and spring only.

name: Go Idaho! Scholarship
amount: $1,000–$7,500 per year based on GPA
eligibility: Idaho resident incoming University of Idaho first-year student; award level is based on unweighted high-school GPA.
description: Guaranteed U of I scholarship funding for qualifying Idaho resident first-year and transfer students.
requirements_raw: Idaho resident first-year student; funding level based on GPA: $1,000 at 3.0–3.39, $4,000 at 3.4–3.749, $5,000 at 3.75–3.899, or $7,500 at 3.9–4.0. Renewable up to four years with 2.5 U of I GPA.

name: Climb Higher Scholarship
amount: Amount varies by GPA and test score
eligibility: Degree-seeking first-time WVU freshman or transfer student who is admitted by the published deadline. Award level is based on high-school or transfer GPA and, for some levels, ACT/SAT score.
description: WVU institutional scholarship program for eligible incoming freshmen and transfer students.
requirements_raw: Degree-seeking first-time freshman or transfer student admitted to a WVU campus by the published deadline; award levels based on incoming high-school or transfer GPA and, where applicable, ACT/SAT score.

name: Hawaiʻi Promise Scholarship
amount: Unmet direct educational costs, including tuition, fees, books, and supplies
eligibility: Hawaiʻi resident or student eligible for in-state tuition enrolled at least half-time in a financial-aid-eligible UH Community College degree program with unmet direct costs.
description: Last-dollar need-based scholarship for qualifying UH Community College students.
requirements_raw: FAFSA; Hawaiʻi residency or in-state tuition exemption; at least 6 credits at a UH Community College; degree-seeking financial-aid-eligible program; unmet direct educational need; no bachelor's degree; satisfactory academic progress. Funding is subject to availability.

name: Granite Guarantee
amount: Full in-state tuition
eligibility: New Hampshire resident, Pell-eligible first-time first-year student or eligible Community College System of New Hampshire transfer student admitted to UNH.
source_name: University of New Hampshire Financial Aid
description: UNH guarantee that qualifying students have in-state tuition covered through grants and scholarships.
requirements_raw: New Hampshire resident; Pell eligible; admitted first-time first-year student, or Pell-eligible Community College System of New Hampshire graduate transfer. Covers in-state tuition only and excludes fees, surcharges, housing, food, and books. File the FAFSA annually and remain full-time to renew for up to four years.

name: Flagship Match Commitment
amount: $14,133-$19,386 per year (published Spring 2026)
eligibility: High-achieving out-of-state first-year applicant from an eligible state admitted to the University of Maine.
description: Merit commitment for eligible out-of-state first-year students, with the award tied to flagship tuition and fees in the student's home state.
requirements_raw: Available to eligible out-of-state first-year students from specified states; minimum 2.5 cumulative GPA. Award amounts vary by the public flagship tuition and fees in the student's home state and are determined during admission review.

name: Grizzly Promise
amount: Amount varies
eligibility: Montana student admitted to the University of Montana with annual family income below $50,000 who files the FAFSA.
description: Need-based UM scholarship and grant commitment for qualifying Montana students.
requirements_raw: Montana student with family income below $50,000 annually; apply for admission and complete the FAFSA. The award is a combination of UM scholarships and grants and may renew for up to four years for students completing at least 12 credits per semester.

name: Rhode Island Promise
amount: Tuition-free associate degree
eligibility: Rhode Island resident age 18 or younger who graduates high school or earns a GED and enrolls at CCRI immediately in an associate degree program.
description: Tuition-free CCRI associate-degree program for eligible recent Rhode Island high-school and GED graduates.
requirements_raw: Rhode Island resident; high school graduate (public, private, or homeschooled) or GED recipient; age 18 or younger, with an appeal option for some students age 19-21; enroll in the term immediately following graduation or GED completion in an associate degree program. To maintain: 2.5 GPA, at least 24 credits in first year, continuous enrollment, and progress toward graduation in two years.

name: First State Promise
amount: Full tuition and mandatory fees for qualifying households; little or no up-front cost below $35,000 family income
eligibility: Delaware resident entering the University of Delaware as a first-year student who meets the family-income requirements and files the FAFSA annually.
description: Need-based University of Delaware financial package for qualifying Delaware first-year students.
requirements_raw: Delaware resident entering UD as a freshman. Family income below $35,000: package covers tuition, fees, standard housing, and food expenses; $35,000-$75,000: package covers full tuition and mandatory fees. FAFSA is required each year; household size and assets can affect eligibility. Not for transfer students.

name: Jackrabbit Guarantee Scholarship Program
amount: $1,000-$4,000 per year (2026-27 published guarantee)
eligibility: First-time freshman admitted to South Dakota State University; guarantee level is based on high-school GPA and, when submitted, ACT or SAT scores.
description: Automatic minimum academic scholarship guarantee for qualifying SDSU first-time freshmen.
requirements_raw: No separate scholarship application. For Spring 2026 through Spring 2027 first-time freshmen, qualifying awards range from $1,000 to $4,000 based on high-school GPA and ACT/SAT scores. Students beginning with a 3.0 GPA can qualify. Continued awards may be available for up to four years with published credit and GPA requirements.

name: NDSU Tuition Award Program
amount: Remaining base undergraduate tuition and mandatory student fees for the first two years
eligibility: Eligible North Dakota or Minnesota student enrolled at NDSU who meets the program's FAFSA and income requirements; Fall 2026 eligibility is limited to graduates from Cass County, North Dakota and Clay County, Minnesota.
description: Last-dollar NDSU tuition program for eligible students that applies after other scholarships and grants.
requirements_raw: Covers remaining base undergraduate tuition and mandatory student fees after scholarships and grants for the first two years. FAFSA is required each year. Current eligibility runs through Spring 2027 for eligible enrolled North Dakota and Minnesota students; Fall 2026 entrants must be high-school graduates from Cass County, ND or Clay County, MN. Does not cover books, housing, meal plan, new student fee, or miscellaneous charges.

name: Alaska Performance Scholarship
provider: University of Alaska Anchorage / State of Alaska
amount: $3,000-$7,000 per year; maximum $28,000
gpa_requirement: 2.5 high-school GPA or qualifying test score
eligibility: Alaska resident who graduated from an Alaska high school and meets the Alaska Performance Scholarship curriculum and achievement requirements.
source_name: University of Alaska Anchorage Financial Aid
description: Renewable state scholarship usable by eligible Alaska high-school graduates at UAA and other qualifying Alaska postsecondary programs.
requirements_raw: Alaska resident and Alaska high-school graduate. Three award levels are based on required curriculum plus GPA or SAT/ACT/WorkKeys achievement; UAA lists awards of $3,000-$7,000 annually, renewable up to a $28,000 maximum. Complete the FAFSA by the stated priority deadline when using the award.

name: Green and Gold Scholarship
amount: Amount varies; $2,000 annually for tuition-remission-eligible nominees
eligibility: Vermont resident and academically strongest student nominated by an eligible Vermont secondary school, admitted to and attending the University of Vermont.
source_name: University of Vermont Student Financial Services
description: Academic merit scholarship with an Honors College invitation for selected Vermont high-school nominees.
requirements_raw: A principal or designee from each eligible Vermont high school nominates its most academically talented rising senior. Nominees must meet UVM entrance requirements, apply by January 15, choose UVM by May 1, be Vermont residents under UVM rules, and graduate from the nominating school. Some eligible border-school conditions apply. Tuition-remission-eligible nominees receive $2,000 annually.

name: Hathaway Scholarship
provider: University of Wyoming / State of Wyoming
amount: Amount varies by Hathaway level
eligibility: Wyoming resident and Wyoming high-school, home-school, or HSEC graduate who meets the Hathaway curriculum, GPA, and standardized-test requirements.
source_name: University of Wyoming Scholarships and Financial Aid
description: Multi-level state scholarship administered at UW for qualifying Wyoming students.
requirements_raw: Wyoming resident; Wyoming high-school, home-school, or HSEC graduate; apply within four years of graduation (or before age 21 for home-school graduates); complete the Hathaway Success Curriculum; meet level-specific GPA and standardized-test requirements; be a U.S. citizen or qualifying eligible noncitizen. Students must be fully admitted to UW and complete Hathaway verification to receive funds.

name: Texas Advance Commitment
amount: Amount varies based on financial need
eligibility: Texas resident undergraduate pursuing a first bachelor's degree with financial need and family AGI up to $125,000.
source_name: University of Texas at Austin Admissions
description: UT Austin need-based commitment automatically considered for eligible admitted freshmen, transfer, and continuing students.
requirements_raw: There is no separate Texas Advance Commitment application. Be admitted to UT Austin, submit FAFSA or TASFA, have financial need, pursue a first bachelor's degree, and meet the Texas-residency and family-AGI requirements listed by UT Austin.

name: Florida Bright Futures Scholarship Program
amount: Amount varies by award level
gpa_requirement: 3.0 weighted GPA for Florida Medallion; 3.5 weighted GPA for Florida Academic
eligibility: Florida student completing required coursework, service or paid work hours, and qualifying test scores.
description: State scholarship program with multiple merit award levels for eligible Florida students.
requirements_raw: Florida Academic Scholars: 3.5 weighted GPA, 100 service/work hours, required coursework, and qualifying test score. Florida Medallion: 3.0 weighted GPA, 75 service hours or 100 paid work hours, required coursework, and qualifying test score. Submit the Florida Financial Aid Application.

name: Excelsior Scholarship
provider: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation
amount: Remaining tuition at SUNY or CUNY
eligibility: New York resident with household federal adjusted gross income of $125,000 or less attending SUNY or CUNY full time.
description: Last-dollar state scholarship covering tuition at SUNY and CUNY for qualifying students.
requirements_raw: New York State legal resident for 12 continuous months; U.S. citizen or eligible noncitizen or qualifying DREAM Act applicant; household federal AGI $125,000 or less; SUNY/CUNY undergraduate; full-time at 12 credits per term and 30 credits per year; FAFSA and TAP or DREAM Act application annually; post-graduation New York live-and-work requirement applies.

name: PA State Grant Program
amount: Amount varies
eligibility: Eligible Pennsylvania student with financial need attending an approved postsecondary institution.
description: Pennsylvania need-based state grant program.
requirements_raw: Submit the FAFSA to begin the PA State Grant process, then complete required PHEAA GrantUs action items. Eligibility and award amount depend on program rules, financial need, enrollment, and approved institution.

name: Monetary Award Program Grant
amount: Up to $8,400 per academic year
eligibility: Illinois resident with financial need attending an approved Illinois college.
description: Need-based Illinois grant applied toward undergraduate tuition and mandatory fees.
requirements_raw: Illinois resident with financial need at an approved Illinois institution. FAFSA or Alternative Application for Illinois Financial Aid is the annual application. Funding is limited, so apply early.

name: Ohio Governor's Merit Scholarship
amount: Up to $5,000 per year for up to four years
eligibility: Ohio high-school graduate identified in the top 5% of their class who enrolls at an eligible Ohio institution.
description: State merit award for nominated high-achieving Ohio high-school graduates.
requirements_raw: High school nominates students in the top 5% based on junior-year GPA. Award is up to $5,000 annually for up to four years at an eligible Ohio institution. Renew with 3.0 cumulative GPA, at least 20 credits per academic year, and degree progress.

name: Zell Miller Scholarship
amount: Full standard tuition assistance at eligible Georgia institutions
eligibility: Georgia resident meeting Zell Miller academic and test-score requirements.
description: Georgia merit scholarship with full standard tuition assistance for qualifying residents.
requirements_raw: Georgia resident; 3.70 high-school GPA calculated by GSFC; minimum 1200 SAT or equivalent ACT composite score; meet additional program eligibility and enrollment requirements.

name: Next NC Scholarship
provider: North Carolina State Education Assistance Authority
amount: At least $3,000 at community colleges or $5,000 at public universities
eligibility: North Carolina resident with household adjusted gross income of $80,000 or less attending an eligible North Carolina public institution.
description: State financial-aid program combining federal and state support for eligible North Carolina students.
requirements_raw: North Carolina resident; household adjusted gross income $80,000 or less; complete FAFSA; enroll in an eligible North Carolina community college or public university for at least 6 credit hours per semester. Award is at least $3,000 at community colleges or $5,000 at public universities, subject to published rules.

name: Michigan Achievement Scholarship
amount: Up to $5,500 per year for up to five years at eligible universities
eligibility: Michigan resident high-school graduate from the class of 2023 or later with financial need who enrolls full-time at an eligible Michigan institution.
description: State scholarship for recent Michigan graduates attending eligible Michigan colleges and universities.
requirements_raw: Complete FAFSA; Michigan resident since July 1 of the prior calendar year; U.S. citizen, permanent resident, or approved refugee; Michigan diploma/equivalency in 2023 or later; demonstrate financial need; enroll full-time at an eligible institution within 15 months of graduation; maintain FAFSA, residence, financial need, full-time enrollment, and satisfactory progress for renewal.

name: Cal Grant Program
amount: Amount varies by Cal Grant type and school
eligibility: Eligible California student attending a participating California college who completes FAFSA or CADAA and meets Cal Grant requirements.
description: California state grant program for eligible students at participating colleges.
requirements_raw: Submit FAFSA or California Dream Act Application and have GPA information submitted by the applicable award-cycle deadline. Eligibility and amounts vary by Cal Grant type, financial need, GPA, residency, and participating institution. California Dream Act applicants may use CADAA for state financial aid eligibility.

name: Alimento-Niere Scholarship
eligibility: Student with at least 25% Philippine parentage pursuing an eligible bachelor’s degree at a designated Southern California college.
major: architecture, engineering, landscape architecture, planning and urban design, computer science, surveying, construction management
description: 2026 scholarship for qualifying Southern California students in architecture, engineering, computer science, and related fields.
requirements_raw: At least 25% Philippine parentage; bachelor’s study in an eligible field at a UC, CSU, USC, DeVry, Woodbury, or another Southern California college. Submit recommendations, resume, personal statement, essay, transcript, and proof of citizenship and Philippine lineage. The 2026 deadline is October 3.

name: AUID Undergraduate Scholarship
eligibility: Current undergraduate interior design or interior architecture student at an accredited institution, or a 2026 graduate.
description: 2026 cash scholarship for accredited interior design and interior architecture students.
requirements_raw: Be a current undergraduate interior design or interior architecture student at an accredited institution, or a 2026 graduate. Submit a cover letter, resume, interior-design portfolio, and recommendation. The 2026 deadline is September 18 at noon Eastern.

name: AACN² Pathway to Critical Care Nursing Scholarship
provider: American Association of Critical-Care Nurses / Foundation for Academic Nursing
eligibility: Student enrolled in an entry-level baccalaureate nursing program who is interested in critical-care practice.
description: 2026 scholarship supporting baccalaureate nursing students preparing for critical-care practice.
requirements_raw: Be enrolled in an entry-level baccalaureate nursing program and committed to critical-care practice. The official 2026 application deadline is September 1.

name: PAVE Global Scholarship + Experience
amount: Amount varies by program
eligibility: Full-time undergraduate or graduate student at a North American institution studying design, architecture, visual merchandising, or a related discipline.
description: Scholarship and experience programs for students pursuing design and built-environment careers.
requirements_raw: Be a full-time undergraduate or graduate student at a North American institution studying design, architecture, visual merchandising, or a related discipline. Individual award criteria vary; the published deadline for the current listed opportunity is October 21, 2026.

name: Teachers of Illinois Scholarship Program
amount: Up to $7,500
eligibility: Illinois student pursuing education who graduated from, and commits to teach in, eligible underserved Illinois school districts.
description: Illinois scholarship for future teachers who commit to serving eligible underserved districts.
requirements_raw: Be an Illinois student pursuing an education degree, have graduated from an eligible underserved school district, and commit to teach in an eligible underserved Illinois district. Apply annually using the program application and FAFSA or the Alternative Application.

name: Chester O. McCorkle Jr. Student Scholarship
amount: Up to $2,000
eligibility: Graduate student conducting applied research on economic issues relating to agriculture.
description: 2026 research scholarship for graduate students studying agricultural economics.
requirements_raw: Be a graduate student conducting applied research on economic issues relating to agriculture. Submit a proposed-research description, itemized budget, advisor letter of support, and graduate transcript. The 2026 deadline is October 12.

name: UnitedAg Vocational Scholarship Program
eligibility: Employee affiliated with an active UnitedAg member company pursuing agriculture-specific vocational education or training.
description: 2026-27 vocational scholarship for eligible UnitedAg-affiliated employees pursuing agricultural training.
requirements_raw: Applicant must be an employee affiliated with an active UnitedAg member company and pursue agriculture-specific education or training at a certified vocational school, trade school, or other institution. Submit the online application, a one-page resume with photo, two recommendations, and a video personal statement. The deadline is December 31, 2026.

name: Computer Science as a Career Scholarship
amount: Up to $7,700 per academic year for up to two years
description: Dallas College scholarship for new and current students pursuing computer science careers.
requirements_raw: Study or intend to study computer science; 2.8 minimum GPA; U.S. citizen or permanent resident; demonstrated financial need with FAFSA completed; enrollment in at least 7 credits per semester; complete the Dallas College Foundation general application and program supplemental questions. Final 2026 deadline: August 15.

name: FAU College of Business Scholarship
provider: Florida Atlantic University College of Business
amount: Amount varies
source_name: Florida Atlantic University College of Business
description: Merit scholarship for FAU College of Business undergraduate and graduate students.
requirements_raw: Be an FAU College of Business undergraduate or graduate student with at least a 3.0 GPA. The committee also reviews personal statement, community service, extracurricular activities, and resume. Fall 2026 application deadline: September 13.

name: FAU Rose Memorial Scholarship
provider: Florida Atlantic University College of Business
amount: Amount varies
source_name: Florida Atlantic University College of Business
description: Merit scholarship for outstanding FAU College of Business students.
requirements_raw: Be an outstanding FAU College of Business undergraduate or graduate student with at least a 3.0 GPA. Spring 2027 application deadline: January 24.

name: David W. Matte Scholarship
provider: Florida Atlantic University College of Business
amount: Amount varies
source_name: Florida Atlantic University College of Business
description: Scholarship for full-time FAU College of Business undergraduates.
requirements_raw: Be a full-time FAU College of Business undergraduate with at least a 3.0 GPA. Preference is given to International Business majors. Fall 2026 application deadline: September 13.

name: Shaun M. Davis Scholarship
provider: Florida Atlantic University College of Business
amount: Amount varies
source_name: Florida Atlantic University College of Business
description: Need-based scholarship for disadvantaged FAU College of Business students.
requirements_raw: Be an FAU College of Business undergraduate or graduate student with demonstrated financial need and at least a 3.0 GPA. The review also considers a personal statement, service, extracurricular activities, and resume. Fall 2026 deadline: September 13.

name: Louis J. Prenner Memorial Scholarship
provider: Florida Atlantic University College of Business
amount: Amount varies
source_name: Florida Atlantic University College of Business
description: Merit scholarship for FAU students studying management and entrepreneurship.
requirements_raw: Be an FAU College of Business undergraduate or graduate student in Management & Entrepreneurship with at least a 3.0 GPA. Extracurricular involvement is considered. Fall 2026 deadline: September 13.

name: FAU Business Leader of the Year Scholarship
provider: Florida Atlantic University College of Business
amount: Amount varies
source_name: Florida Atlantic University College of Business
description: Merit scholarship for FAU College of Business students with service leadership.
requirements_raw: Be an FAU College of Business undergraduate or graduate student with at least a 3.25 GPA and demonstrated leadership through service. Recipients must register for the upcoming semester and attend the required appreciation video and Business Leader of the Year event. Spring 2027 deadline: January 24.

name: Scholarship for Engineering Education (SEE)
provider: Mercer University / Georgia Student Finance Commission
amount: Up to $3,500 per year; renewable up to eight semesters
description: Georgia forgivable-loan scholarship for Mercer engineering students, including Computer and Electrical Engineering.
requirements_raw: Georgia resident; full-time Mercer BSE student in an approved ABET engineering specialization; 2.5 overall cumulative HOPE GPA; annual application. Recipients agree to work in an engineering-related field in Georgia after graduation or repay the balance.

name: Cybersecurity Public Service Scholarship Program
amount: Amount set by MHEC; may cover tuition, mandatory fees, room, and board
description: Maryland scholarship for students nearing completion of an approved cybersecurity degree or certificate, with a Maryland public-service work obligation.
requirements_raw: Enrolled at a Maryland public or private nonprofit institution in an approved cybersecurity degree or certificate; within three years of graduation; at least 3.0 GPA; completed 25% of program credits. Application through MDCAPS with transcript and institutional verification. Recipients must complete a Maryland cybersecurity public-service obligation or repay with interest.

name: CyberCorps Scholarship for Service
amount: Full tuition and education-related fees plus program support
description: Cybersecurity scholarship for NC State computer-science students who agree to a government internship and post-graduation service commitment.
requirements_raw: U.S. citizen or permanent resident; full-time NC State Computer Science student pursuing the cybersecurity concentration, or an admitted applicant; able to receive a security clearance. Requires a government cybersecurity internship and post-graduation government service for a period equal to scholarship support.

name: CyberCorps Scholarship for Service
amount: Full tuition and mandatory fees; $27,000 undergraduate stipend; $6,000 annual professional-development fund
major: computer science, computer engineering, information systems, cybersecurity
description: Cybersecurity scholarship for eligible UMBC students with an internship and public-sector service commitment.
requirements_raw: U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident; minimum 3.0 GPA; full-time approved UMBC cybersecurity-aligned program; junior standing with 60 credits or higher; ability to obtain security clearance; required internship and post-graduation government cybersecurity service.

name: CyberCorps Scholarship for Service
amount: Scholarship support for engineering-based AI and cybersecurity study
major: computer science, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, engineering
description: Texas A&M CyberAICorps scholarship for upper-level AI and cybersecurity students who commit to government service.
requirements_raw: U.S. citizen or permanent resident; full-time Texas A&M student; undergraduate junior or senior, or graduate student, in engineering-based AI or cybersecurity; minimum 3.0 GPA; eligible for government employment and possible security clearance; required government work commitment equal to support period.

name: CyberCorps Scholarship for Service
amount: 100% tuition and fees plus cost-of-living and professional-development support
source_name: UAH Center for Cybersecurity Research and Education
description: UAH cybersecurity scholarship with required summer internship and federal-service commitment.
requirements_raw: CyberCorps recipients receive tuition, fees, stipend, and professional-development support. Recipients must participate in a summer internship and maintain eligible federal cybersecurity employment after graduation for at least the number of scholarship years awarded.

name: CyberCorps Scholarship for Service
amount: Amount varies; NSF-funded cybersecurity scholarship support
major: computer science, cybersecurity, digital forensics, data science
description: UAB CyberCorps scholarship supporting cybersecurity, digital-forensics, computer-science, and data-science pathways with public-service preparation.
requirements_raw: NSF-funded CyberCorps program at UAB for cybersecurity-related undergraduate and graduate pathways. Review the official program for current cohort, application, internship, citizenship, and service requirements before applying.

name: CyberCorps Scholarship for Service
amount: Amount varies
description: Cybersecurity scholarship for qualifying Cal Poly Pomona students with a required government cybersecurity service period.
requirements_raw: Full-time student within the stated time to graduation in a cybersecurity or information-assurance program; U.S. citizen; meet federal-employment criteria; able to obtain a security clearance when required; work for an approved government agency after graduation for a period equal to scholarship funding.

name: CyberCorps Scholarship for Service
provider: University of Texas at San Antonio
amount: Amount varies
description: NSF Scholarship for Service support for UTSA computer and cybersecurity students with government-service obligations.
requirements_raw: UTSA's NSF Scholarship for Service supports graduate and undergraduate students pursuing computer or cybersecurity study. Review the official program for its current eligibility, application, internship, citizenship, and post-graduation government-service requirements.

name: AZSecure CyberCorps Scholarship for Service
amount: Amount varies
source_name: University of Arizona Eller College of Management
description: University of Arizona CyberCorps pathway for cybersecurity students who agree to work in an approved government cybersecurity role after graduation.
requirements_raw: CyberCorps participants pursue approved information-assurance study and agree to serve in an approved federal, state, local, tribal, territorial, or approved research government role after completing degree requirements. The service period depends on the scholarship length.

name: ESET Women in Cybersecurity Scholarship
amount: Amount varies
description: Scholarship for women pursuing cybersecurity, technology, or related STEM education in the United States or Canada.
requirements_raw: Applicant must be enrolled in or accepted to an accredited U.S. or Canadian college or university and demonstrate interest in cybersecurity, technology, or related STEM fields. Review the current official terms for all eligibility and application conditions.

name: ISACA SheLeadsTech Scholarship
major: information technology, cybersecurity, IT audit, risk, governance, assurance
description: Worldwide scholarship for women pursuing undergraduate or graduate study in IT audit, risk, cybersecurity, governance, or assurance.
requirements_raw: Women pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree related to IT audit, risk, cybersecurity, governance, or assurance may apply. Review the official annual application requirements and award conditions.

name: Oklahoma Women in Technology Scholarship
description: Annual scholarship for women pursuing undergraduate or graduate STEM programs.
requirements_raw: Female applicants must be at least 18 by the stated award date and be undergraduate or graduate students pursuing a STEM degree through an accredited program. Review the official page for Oklahoma residency and annual application details.

name: ASME Engineering Scholarship for 2-Year Programs
amount: Amount varies
major: mechanical engineering, mechanical engineering technology, aerospace, bioengineering, mechatronics
description: ASME scholarship opportunity for community-college and two-year engineering or engineering-technology students, including students transferring to four-year programs.
requirements_raw: Pursue mechanical engineering, mechanical engineering technology, or a closely related field such as aerospace, bioengineering, or mechatronics. Applicants need a viable college transcript and GPA from at least one postsecondary semester. Review the official application for the current cycle and additional criteria.
